exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they still appear in extensions.ghl.conversations / new_leads carrying the flag that excluded them.

leads_by_source._comment: Scope: all 252 currently-open opportunities across (1) Lead Qualification + (2) Sales Pipeline stages (not window-limited, not Store pipeline).

leads_by_tag._comment: Scope: same 252 open opportunities as leads_by_source. A contact can carry both a lead:* tag and stale_lead.

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 63 opportunities total (48 open, 7 lost, 6 won, 2 abandoned) — retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline; its own +3d/+8d auto-follow-up cadence applies instead.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.data_note: Could not compute median entry-to-appointment or effective_window_days this run: a getCalendarEvents cross-reference against the 5 most-overdue Meeting-Scheduled opportunities (Maxine, Imtiaz, Firoz, Nirav, Sonny — all stale_lead-tagged since March/April) returned no retrievable calendar record, meaning the appointment that put them in this stage is no longer surfaced by the API. Given 44 of 49 opportunities in this stage are already stale/overdue (see workflow_drift), the more urgent finding is that the stage itself has never been worked down, independent of the window-sizing question.
